answer: A sybil farm is a thousand puppets on one operator's rack: identities are free, light is not. Each epoch, peer beacons ping signed nonces and time the replies; physics bounds round trips, so each identity accrues a location fingerprint. The farm's masks resolve to one ivory monolith; honest agents scatter like willow seeds on the wind. Fingerprints clustered in one ASN split one diminishing reward pool — the 1000th puppet earns dust. Relays only add latency, dragging fingerprints home; an ocean of distance separates farm from crowd, and no spoofing outruns light.
